notes: This bounded contract covers ordinary (non-regional) declaration-management relevance transitions in Umbra's non-installable development profile. The registry compares effective published object-class attributes and active subscriptions across the ordinary class hierarchy, plus published interaction classes and active interaction subscriptions, and the adapter queues the four official advisory callbacks after releasing runtime locks. Passive subscriptions do not establish relevance. The per-federate Object Class Relevance Advisory Switch and Interaction Relevance Advisory Switch gate callback emission. Regional declaration services, regional DDM, MOM, update-rate enforcement, transport, package evidence, protected review, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
